purpose: Determine whether refitting the already-frozen q10:q15 action head on all lawful Q24-native observer-fit rows materially improves alpha=.75 J without checkpoint or board selection.

data_contract.native_rows: all target-free Q24 native rows, role ranks 0 through 687
data_contract.targets: sealed observer_fit mlp_id and all_layer_means only, opened after all target-free row and fold bindings pass

frozen_recipe.architecture: 22 -> 64 SiLU -> 64 SiLU -> six layer-specific scalar heads
frozen_recipe.features: raw20 channel0, standardized raw20 channels1:20, alpha=.75 J state/rms, physical local J innovation/(sigma*rms)
frozen_recipe.loss: mean six-layer teacher-local squared delta-q error normalized by training-fold q_rms

fold_law.algorithm: sort role ranks by (blake2s-128(salt+':'+mlp_id), mlp_id, role_rank), then assign sorted_position modulo 4
fold_law.evaluation: each observer-fit row is scored exactly once by the model trained without its fold

promotion_law.incumbent: frozen Q_SUFFIX_HEAD.pt evaluated on the exact same 688 alpha=.75 J rows
promotion_law.primary_metric: pooled final-layer raw MSE across all 688 out-of-fold predictions
promotion_law.conjunctive_gate: candidate relative OOF gain >=0.25%, >=3/4 fold means improve, paired network gain z>=2, >=55% of all networks improve, every fold has >=50% network wins, and the legacy protected40 OOF slice does not worsen
promotion_law.final_fit: only after the conjunctive gate; initialize from the same fixed seed and train all 688 rows to fixed epoch13 with stream id4
promotion_law.failure: persist result only; do not create a model
promotion_law.success: persist exactly one frozen full688 q-head scientific model; this is not submission authority
promotion_law.board_transfer_guard: submission 328616 raw 3.065038697513956e-8 versus protected projection 2.8976011020648275e-8 fixes a conservative 1.0577849019072405 board-shift allowance; any later deployment must be evaluated on banked D1 or a validated D1-cap base
